notes.title: Hell's 8 Avenue: Miori's Mysterious Notebook is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/e90ed011e651dbd8c806ba772f264378d222e898.png

We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of Hell's 8 Avenue: Miori's Mysterious Notebook, developed by Magical Ponpon! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641720/Hells_8th_Avenue_Mioris_Mysterious_Notebook/

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=757FZB3Sf1Y;full][/previewyoutube]

In this adventure game, play as Miori, a young detective tasked with finding a missing person and purifying the ominous 'Illusory 8th Street.' Challenge your dexterity with fun Quick Time Events and push forward... or get punished for being too slow.
